Where can I buy tickets?

All tickets are digital and must be purchased at https://www.worldchampionscup.com or https://www.ticketmaster.com/ ahead of the tournament. We cannot verify the legitimacy of tickets purchased anywhere else.

 

What types of tickets are available?

Champions Passes and Skechers Captains Club tickets are available for purchase. Champions Passes are free thanks to our partners at GEICO for Sunday.  All tickets must be purchased by the day (Thursday, Friday and Sunday).

 

Are Championship Sunday presented by GEICO tickets complimentary?

All Champions Passes and Parking is free thanks to our partners at GEICO! Claim your tickets by visiting this link. 

 

What is the youth ticket policy?

Up to four (4) youth, ages fifteen (15) and under have complimentary grounds access with a ticked adult.

 

Is parking included in my ticket purchase?

No, you will need to purchase a parking pass separately at https://www.worldchampionscup.com or https://www.ticketmaster.com/

 

How will parking work?

Parking will be mobile entry only. You will need to have your mobile parking barcode ready to show at the entrance to the parking lot. Fans are strongly encouraged to purchase parking passes in advance for the best pricing and before spots are sold out.

 

What if I am having issues with my digital tickets?

Please visit https://worldchampionscup.com/mobile-ticket-instructions/ for more information on how to access your Skechers World Champions Cup supporting Shriners Children's Tickets.

 

Can I leave tickets for friends, family or clients?

Tickets can be transferred through Account Manager. If you need any assistance, click here for step-by-step instructions.

 

What if I have trouble accessing my tickets when I get to the tournament?

We will have a ticket resolution and customer service box office onsite at the Main Entrance. We will not be selling tickets onsite.

 

How do I receive the most up to date information on the tournament like weather or groupings?

Please follow along on our social media platforms for information on the tournament during the week, and subscribe to our email list to receive the latest updates directly in your inbox.

 

What time is the Opening Ceremony?

The Opening Ceremony will be held on Thursday, December 4th at 8:15 AM. The Opening Ceremony will take place on the 1st Tee and is open to all fans. Be one of the first fans through the gate to score a free Skechers World Champions Cup t-shirt at the First Tee Grandstands presented by The Abaco Club.

 

Where can I purchase food and beverages?

 All food and beverage locations are marked on the course map here for your convenience. Please note that this is a cashless event.

 

Where can I watch the competition?

ABC and ESPN will serve as the exclusive domestic broadcast provider of the Skechers World Champions Cup supporting Shriners Children’s.  Coverage will air Thursday, December 4 and Friday, December 5, as well as Sunday, December 7.  Skechers World Champions Cup supporting Shriners Children’s is partnering with the PGA TOUR’s international broadcast network partners to provide live tournament coverage in more than 130 countries and territories. Domestic broadcast windows are below:

 

Thursday, December 4

8:30 AM – 12:00 PM – ESPN+

12:00 – 4:00 PM – ESPN

 

Friday, December 5

8:30 AM – 12:00 PM – ESPN+

12:00 – 4:00 PM – ESPN

 
Sunday, December 7

8:00 AM – 3:00 PM – ESPN

 

 

What are the shuttle hours and when do gates open?

Thursday, December 4, 2025

Shuttle Hours: 8:00 a.m. – 6 p.m.

Gates Open: 8:00 a.m.

Friday, December 5, 2025

Shuttle Hours: 8:00 a.m. – 6 p.m.

Gates Open: 8:00 a.m.

Sunday, December 7, 2025

Shuttle Hours: 8:00 a.m. – 6 p.m.

Gates Open: 8:30 a.m.

 

What is the best way to get to the event?

 Parking for Purchase

The tournament will offer round-trip shuttle service to the Main Entrance of the Skechers World Champions Cup supporting Shriners Children’s for fans parked in tournament-designated lots. Thursday, Friday & Sunday. General Parking presented by GEICO is located at Franklin Templeton (100 Fountain Parkway N, St. Petersburg, FL 33716). Follow signs for Fountain Parkway North.

 

Rideshare

The Rideshare pick-up/drop-off point location will be at the Feather Sound Country Club - Bay Entrance (2201 Feather Sound Dr, Clearwater, FL 33762) and will be available Thursday, Friday and Sunday. 

 

Bike Racks

Bike racks will be available for use and located at the main entrance for your convenience.

 

Is there ADA parking and ADA accommodation on site?

ADA parking will be located at the General Parking presented by GEICO Franklin Templeton lot with ADA-accessible shuttles to and from the course. The address is 100 Fountain Parkway N, St. Petersburg, FL 33716. A physical permit placard is required for entry. 

 

What is the bag policy?

Please visit https://www.pgatour.com/company/tournaments-prohibited-items for more information.

 

Know before you go

For the fan safety guide that is in effect at all PGA TOUR events, please click here

 

Who should I contact for ticket-related questions?

For Ticketing Inquiries:

WCCtickets@worldchampionscup.com 

 

For Sponsorship & Hospitality Inquiries:

sponsorship@worldchampionscup.com
